cover_headline: Ambani Adds $6.3 Billion in a Day as Reliance Shares Jump 11.6% on Record Quarterly Profit

end.headline: Ambani Adds $6.3 Billion in a Day as Reliance Shares Jump 11.6% on Record Quarterly Profit
end.line: Reliance's best trading session in over six years, driven by a 40.6% rise in September-quarter profit, made Mukesh Ambani the world's biggest gainer on Forbes' real-time rich list and kept him India's richest person.

facts: Mukesh Ambani gained $6.3 billion in one day, taking his net worth to $88.8 billion and 23rd place globally on Forbes' real-time billionaires list
Reliance Industries shares jumped 11.6% to close at Rs 1,300, their strongest session in more than six years
Reliance's profit attributable to shareholders rose 40.6% year on year to Rs 25,548 crore, on revenue up 27.8% to Rs 3.62 lakh crore
